Research
Ongoing Research Projects
Ongoing Research Projects
You can read more about our ongoing research projects below:
GeoStorie
UCD School of Earth Sciences awarded €748,000 for 3-year assessment of Ireland’s offshore potential for geological storage, funded by the SEAI National Energy RD&D Funding Programme and the Geological Survey Ireland.
Click here to read more about the GeoStorie project
GEMINI
Geothermal Energy: €20m (£17.3m) cross border investment in demonstrator projects for public sector buildings on the island of Ireland.
Click here to read more about the GEMINI Project
GREENPEG (2020 - 2024)
GREENPEG work packages (WP) testing mineral exploration methods in south Leinster, Ireland; Tysfjord, Norway; Wolfsberg, Austria.
Click here to read more about GREENPEG
Ireland Subsurface Stress and Geoenergy Programme (ISSGP)
The Ireland Subsurface Stress and Geoenergy Programme (ISSGP) is a UCD-led initiative that characterises in situ stress conditions across Irish basins to inform geothermal energy, subsurface storage, and broader geoenergy applications.
Click here to read more about ISSGP
